Court rejected Meta's Digital Services Act 'no-knowledge' defense, finding Meta controls content via algorithms and ads, citing a June European Court of Justice precedent.
Meta Platforms (META) rose 0.9% premarket and is up 10% since Sept. 8 after strong Muse AI agent downloads; Citi cites Muse as a near-term catalyst ahead of Meta Connect.
